title: dendRoAnalyst 2.0: an expanded R package for preprocessing, integrating, modeling, and analyzing dendrometer data with climate time series
description: Data and R code to reproduce the code examples, analyses, and figures of the manuscript "dendRoAnalyst 2.0: an expanded R package for preprocessing, integrating, modeling, and analyzing dendrometer data with climate time series" (Dendrochronologia, submitted). The repository contains the band dendrometer records of four Pinus sylvestris trees at Tennenlohe, Germany (2022 to 2023), hourly climate data of the DWD station Nuremberg, the R scripts, and the source package of dendRoAnalyst 2.0.1, which was used for the paper.
